narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Borrowed Voice"**

quikform has no visual identity of its own to push. A form page is one white, left-aligned column of about 680 px, bold labels above outlined fields, generous air between questions, and a single brand accent supplied per project. Everything that is not the accent is neutral grey on white, so the page reads as part of whichever gym, barbershop or bakery sent the link. The pinned references are Tally for the page (column, bold labels, lettered choice chips, dark button with an arrow) and Typeform for the step mode (thin progress bar at the top, full-width thumb-reach button stuck to the bottom of the phone screen).

The page works without JavaScript; the script only adds step mode, live validation and a local draft, so the system is styled server-rendered first. It loads nothing external: the Content Security Policy is `default-src 'self'`, so the typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans) and the logo are served by quikform itself and the only icon is an inline SVG arrow. Motion is CSS only, short and small, and switched off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Rejected from the references: banner photos and gradients, "Made with" / "Powered by" badges, placeholder text as the only hint, underline-only fields, cookie banners.
keyCharacteristics: One brand accent per project, every other color neutral.
Plus Jakarta Sans, self-hosted, with a system fallback; no external resources.
Labels always visible above their field, in bold.
Flat white surface; one soft shadow, on the phone's sticky action bar.
Touch targets of 44 px minimum (48 px for buttons and text inputs), WCAG 2.2 AA.

rules.name: The Borrowed Voice Rule
rules.body: The brand accent is the only color a project can change. It appears on the primary action, progress and selected state, nowhere else; no second brand color, no tinted backgrounds, no colored headings.

rules.name: The Computed Contrast Rule
rules.body: Colors derived from the accent are computed against WCAG thresholds, never chosen by eye. A project accent that fails a threshold falls back to black for that role rather than shipping low contrast.

rules.name: The Visible Label Rule
rules.body: Every field has a bold label above it, always visible. Placeholder text is an example, never the label.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label above a title. The step counter lives in the button row, not above the step title.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Fields, chips and buttons never cast shadows. State shows as a border change, never elevation.

rules.name: The Selected Dot Rule
rules.body: Coral appears only as the filled centre of a radio dot: the logo, the list markers of the hero facts and the "why" questions, and the checked tab. Never text, a fill, a border, a link or a background.

rules.name: The White-Label Boundary Rule
rules.body: Brand Ink, Coral and the quikform logo stay on the landing. A form page takes the project's accent and nothing of quikform's.

rules.name: The Code-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: The mono stack sets code, commands and field identifiers (the field lists under each use case). It never sets prose, headings, labels or buttons.

dos: **Do** take the brand accent from the project and compute every derived color (`renderBrandCss`); keep the rest neutral.
**Do** keep every label visible above its field, bold, at the Title size.
**Do** keep every touch target at 44 px or more, buttons and text inputs at 48 px.
**Do** keep inputs at 16 px or more.
**Do** place the privacy note immediately before the action row.
**Do** keep the step counter in the button row.
**Do** keep motion in CSS, under 0.3 s, and removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Landing: Do use Coral only inside a radio dot.
Landing: Do show real captures of quikform forms, framed as a phone, and name the sample brand in the caption.
Landing: Do group content with 1 px rules, not cards.
Landing: Do keep code on ink panels in the mono stack, and let it scroll sideways on phones.
Landing: Do keep buttons at 48 px and tabs at 44 px minimum height.
donts: **Don't** load fonts, icon fonts, CDNs or any resource from another origin; the CSP is `default-src 'self'`. Fonts and the logo are served by quikform.
**Don't** add eyebrow labels above titles or step titles.
**Don't** use placeholder text as the only hint, or underline-only fields.
**Don't** add "Powered by" badges, banner photos, gradients or cookie banners.
**Don't** add shadows to fields, chips or buttons.
**Don't** let a project override the neutral greys or the error red.
Landing: Don't add eyebrow labels above titles.
Landing: Don't use Coral for text, links, fills or borders.
Landing: Don't use decorative gradients; the only gradients are the drawn dot centre and the phone code panels' scroll-edge cue.
Landing: Don't add shadows to buttons, tabs or panels.
Landing: Don't use JavaScript for motion; tabs and panels work with native radios and CSS.
Landing: Don't put the quikform logo, Coral or Brand Ink on a form page.

brandSurface.overview: A white page set in ink, one coral dot that only ever means "selected", dark ink code panels beside real phone captures of the form. Content is grouped by thin rules, never by cards. The page shows the JSON an agent writes and the form it becomes, side by side.
